loss_policy: Retain the longest supported prefix before first loss in each fixed .5s initialization bin, only if the unchanged .25s minimum is met. Remainder stays Unverified; never bridge or retry across a loss.
coherence_model: Partial affine consistency of the same persistent source features permits image rotation/scale. No projected polygon or hidden boundary is created. Residual threshold unchanged. Independent rotating-texture control precedes real replay.
basis: Feature/LK settings and minimum 3 retained features reuse one_real_case/tracking_plan.json. Window, motion/stability tolerances reuse visual_events/policy.json. Coherence residual 2px, 60% survival, 15% support hull and correlation .65 reuse assisted_end_effector_sprint/PLAN.json. Frozen before evaluating the new cube replay; not fit to task-outcome labels.
scope: Feature correspondences inside SAM masks; not full-object anchors, fingertips, physical poses or absolute error bounds. Object identity inherits an unverified model query. Reinitialize only at fixed source-clock windows, never bridge unsupported frames. All semantic motion/stability candidates remain Inferred.
